verses.pali: “Yo kho, bhikkhave, cakkhusamphassajāya vedanāya uppādo ṭhiti …pe… jarāmaraṇassa pātubhāvo …pe….
verses.english: “Mendicants, the arising of feeling born of eye contact …
the arising of feeling born of mind contact …
is the manifestation of old age and death.

verses.pali: Yo ca kho, bhikkhave, cakkhusamphassajāya vedanāya nirodho vūpasamo …pe…
verses.english: The cessation of feeling born of eye contact …

verses.pali: yo manosamphassajāya vedanāya nirodho vūpasamo atthaṅgamo, dukkhasseso nirodho, rogānaṁ vūpasamo, jarāmaraṇassa atthaṅgamo”ti.
verses.english: the cessation of feeling born of mind contact … is the disappearance of old age and death.”
